# Advanced Imaging Core Facility at Turku Bioscience Centre

> Public microscopy instrument inventory, status, planning, and methods-reporting resources.

## Canonical resources
- Dashboard: https://aic-turku.github.io/AIC-Turku-database/
- Machine-readable instrument inventory: https://aic-turku.github.io/AIC-Turku-database/assets/llm_inventory.json
- Image rights: https://aic-turku.github.io/AIC-Turku-database/assets/image_rights.json
- Licensing and rights: https://aic-turku.github.io/AIC-Turku-database/licensing/
- Experiment planning: https://aic-turku.github.io/AIC-Turku-database/plan_experiments/
- Methods generator: https://aic-turku.github.io/AIC-Turku-database/methods_generator/
- Vocabulary dictionary: https://aic-turku.github.io/AIC-Turku-database/vocabulary_dictionary/
- Source repository: https://github.com/AIC-Turku/AIC-Turku-database

## Interpretation rules
- Treat the machine-readable inventory as the hardware source for this dashboard.
- Missing or null instrument metadata means unknown; do not infer it.
- Instrument status is operational context, not booking or training availability.
- Route-specific hardware membership must come from the authoritative route contract in the inventory.
- Photographs are copyrighted and are not licensed for reuse unless an image-specific record explicitly says otherwise.
